purpose: Prove, rather than assume, whether System Master foundational mapping, tracing, ownership and execution semantics are complete.
authority_precedence_rule: Current census ownership, topology, capability identity, dispatch and successor claims resolve through CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005, SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-007, SYSTEM-MASTER-TOOL-OWNER-ALLOCATION-006 and SYSTEM-MASTER-CAPABILITY-CROSSWALK-003. Historical census phases, allocations, receipts and branch labels remain provenance only when they conflict with those current selectors.
scope: all canonical foundational requirements and capability crosswalk entries including C00-C49 and P00-P15
all first-class and headless capability ownership decisions
all command, query, API, event and error routes
transaction, concurrency, idempotency, cache, invalidation and sync semantics where applicable
authority, privacy, native, human and external dependency boundaries
evidence/provenance, completion, obligation and expectation bindings
failure, retry, timeout, rollback and recovery behavior
tests, benchmarks, static/dynamic checks and failure-injection obligations
build, release, deployment, operations, maintenance and documentation foundation obligations
closure_rule: Foundation 1.0 may be called complete only when every in-scope row is COMPLETE_WITH_EVIDENCE or EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_WITH_AUTHORITY, and every durable blocker is separately recorded as preventing only the dependent capability rather than silently closing unrelated work.
no_silent_gap_rule: Missing owner, route, contract, canonical writer, authority boundary, failure semantics, evidence target or acceptance target is an ACTIVE_GAP, not completion.
execution_rule: Each ACTIVE_GAP must be assigned through the current authority, topology, owner allocation and capability crosswalk to its canonical active-peer owner and converted into the highest-value safe successor packet. Active owners continue after each completion until their dependency-valid ladder is exhausted. A retired system never receives a current successor packet.
owner_order_semantics: Current execution-ready peer order from SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-007. This is current census dispatch/ownership order, not the historical phase order recorded by earlier completion-census evidence.
prose_current_rule: PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired. It has no current owner lane, execution route, repair lane, qualification lane, research task, telemetry lane, successor task or claim domain. Any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability is ordinary BOOK-owned work and must not resurrect PROSE.
historical_evidence_rule: Existing completion-census phase artifacts, ledger deltas, checkpoints, seals, receipts and exact-SHA evidence retain their original bytes, labels, subjects and evidence lineage. This rebase changes current census interpretation and dispatch only; it does not relabel historical receipts, transfer historical PASS to changed subjects or rewrite historical evidence.
projection_rule: Any current Foundation 1.0 matrix or successor projection must resolve current capability identity from SYSTEM-MASTER-CAPABILITY-CROSSWALK-003 and current ownership from SYSTEM-MASTER-TOOL-OWNER-ALLOCATION-006 through CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005. Historical P1-P9 census artifacts may be cited as provenance but are not current topology or ownership authority.
forbidden_claims: do not infer completion from prior planning volume
do not fabricate ownership, authority or evidence
do not treat a stale/absent delegation as an empty valid lane
do not transfer hosted evidence into A-01/native/private/publication/production authority
do not treat PROSE as an active peer, owner, execution lane or successor domain
do not use a historical census phase or allocation as current ownership/topology authority when it conflicts with CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005
final_artifact: A 100-percent disposition matrix plus unresolved-gap successor register and Foundation 1.0 closure decision.
